research_question: Does Kernal reproduce the observable TTY/PTTY and job-control contract required by unchanged Debian 13 ARM64 without broadening device authority?
negative_controls: foreign or unowned TTY/device authority must be rejected
stale PTY/session/foreground-process-group generations must be rejected
invalid ioctl and bad user pointers must fail explicitly rather than fake success

repetition_policy.timing_metrics: report distribution and variance; never publish a single-run latency claim

promotion_rule.to_measured: all declared metrics must come from executed evidence tied to one exact tested commit; hard-zero metrics must be zero
promotion_rule.to_replicated: independent reproduction of the same pinned profile and evidence contract is required
